description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ReportMailingJobNotFoundException' which extends 'AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException'. It is used to indicate that a specific report mailing job resource could not be found, identified by its ID. The class provides constructors that generate standardized error messages including the job ID, and it is part of the report mailing job exception handling within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating that a report mailing job resource with a specified ID was not found. Extends the abstract exception class for platform resource not found errors, providing constructors to include relevant error messages and optional cause exception.

methods.name: ReportMailingJobNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a report mailing job ID, initializes exception with a standard error message identifying the missing resource.

methods.name: ReportMailingJobNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor accepting a report mailing job ID and a cause exception, allowing chaining of the underlying data access exception.
